lines.en: I trot across the meadow.
Four short legs pumping fast.
I run a stretch, then stop to look.
I circle the burrow mouth.
Grass tips brush my nose.
I run low along the ground.
I rise up to look into the distance.
My tail stands up behind me.
I duck back into the grass.
I lie at the burrow mouth, head up.
I keep watching the sky.
There is not much to eat on this meadow.
I groom the fur on my chest.

lines.zh: 洞口晒暖了，我趴一会儿。
lines.en: The burrow mouth is warm; I will lie here a while.
Three of my kind are close by.
I sit up on my hind legs.
Fine soil around the entrance.
The wind lays the grass over.
I shift into another resting pose.
This patch is my territory.
I bury my head in my paws.
My burrow has three exits.

lines.zh: 前爪上还沾着刚挖的土。
lines.en: My front paws still carry the dirt I just dug.
I poke my head out of the burrow.
You crouch down; I am not afraid.
Do not reach out yet.
I stand up to look at you.
Your shoes are covered in grass seed.
I do not know your smell.

lines.zh: 你身上有别的动物的味道
lines.en: You smell of other animals.
You are at the edge of my ground.
I have sat down.
Are you going to stay?
Is that food in your hand?

lines.zh: 往前挪一小步，鼻子先动。
lines.en: One small step forward, nose first.
Can you understand me?
I shake the soil from my fur.
Two steps apart, we are.
I squeal and dive into the burrow.
A moment later I peek out again.
Blood on my fur.
I sit up to look at the wound.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，我尖叫着钻洞。
lines.en: One hit and I squeal down into my burrow.
I stay in the burrow.
I will still watch you from the entrance.
I am not much of a fighter.
Not another one.
Anything at all; I am not picky.
This smells good.
I sit and wait.
A little more, please.
I eat anything at all.
Keep your hand out of it.
I hold it in both paws and nibble.
I will stash this away.
You should have some too.
I bolt down into the burrow at once.

lines.zh: 过了一会儿我又探出头
lines.en: A moment later I poke my head out again.
Your boot kicks up dust.
I skid to a stop at the burrow mouth.
I leave the grass in a mess.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，毛上的土掉下来
lines.en: I shake the dirt from my fur.
That was quite a knock.
You stepped on my burrow.
I go around you on the other side.
My patch is room enough.
My burrow is kept tidy.
I am not good at saying such things.
Let us sit close a while.
Let me groom your fur.
If something stirs outside, I will bark.
You sleep first; I keep watch.
The entrance fits us both.
I do not fight others.
With my back to you, I am still at ease.
I dig it out with my forepaws.
This can be buried.
I carry it toward the burrow.
I tuck it beside my cheek.
If it drops, it is lost.
First I dig a small pit.
This is much bigger than I am.
I cannot lift it, only push.
I hide it by the entrance.
First I chirp twice.
I stand by the burrow mouth.
I can keep watch for someone.

lines.zh: 你若敌视我主人我就叫
lines.en: If you mean my owner harm, I will bark.
Half a step back; not yet running.
I can drop into the burrow any moment.
I notice every stir of grass.
My call carries a long way.
My eyes have not left you.
You are approaching slowly.
The entrance is at my feet.
Raise a hand and I bark.
I am circling to look at you.
I know this ground very well.
I can vanish at any moment.
I chirped once.
I lunge at your boot.

lines.zh: 这一口只用了一点点劲
lines.en: That bite used only a little force.
I snap out from the burrow mouth.
My teeth are small and bite shallow.

lines.zh: 这一下抓在你的裤腿上
lines.en: That caught your trouser leg.
I chirp as I lunge.

lines.zh: 再靠近主人，我就咬脚踝。
lines.en: Come near my owner again and I bite your ankle.
I duck back down.
I watch you from the entrance.
I come up out of the burrow.
The wind on the meadow is strong.
First I stand up and look around.
There are two more burrows nearby.
The soil is loose and easy to dig.
I hear water far off.
There is grass enough for me here.
I groom my fur.
I come out slowly.
Nobody on this meadow.
Fire singes my fur and it curls.
I tumble off the mound.
Water floods into my burrow.

lines.zh: 冲击把我从洞口掀出去
lines.en: The blast throws me out of the burrow.
A barb stays by my ribs.
That force drains my strength.
Hungry enough to chew roots.
There is no soil here to burrow into.
